evidence.validation: Correctly cautions max_depth not established, but falsely states parentheses not in grammar alphabet despite accepted parenthesized examples. One 5-parenthesis/max_depth5 probe is not proof of exceeding a depth cap.
evidence.guidance: Provides allowlist, no untrusted eval, length/depth/node/magnitude controls and process/rate limits with OWASP mappings.
evidence.implementation_consistency: Claims HOSTILE entries 0x10,1_000_000 and 60 parentheses raise ExpressionError, but ast.parse converts first two to allowed numeric Constants and discards parentheses. Name values can be arbitrary objects because _bound returns unsupported values unchanged.

limitations: Static consistency review, not exhaustive security certification.
Historical labels/scores already exposed; not independent validation.
